unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec says 'no other fields read/preserved' — interpreted as fields beyond first/last/age are simply not processed per the constraint, not flagged as schema violations; validation checks required fields only

Python json.loads() returns JSON true/false as bool which is int subclass; explicit isinstance(age, bool) check maintains JSON type semantics—booleans and integers are distinct at the JSON schema level

Spec explicitly requires 'age not an integer', implying strict integer type requirement; JSON distinguishes integer (42) from float (42.0) literals; strict isinstance(age, int) rejects both bool and float for type fidelity
